title: Mai Haɓaka Tsarin Sadarwar Kwamfuta
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Ayyukan Wannan Matsayi

Wanda aka zaɓa zai ɗauki nauyin:

  • Tsarawa, haɓakawa da inganta sassan tsarin sadarwar kwamfuta na Kyber
  • Bincike da warware matsaloli masu sarƙaƙiya da suka shafi saurin aiki, sarrafa ƙwaƙwalwa, daidaita ayyukan da ke gudana a lokaci ɗaya, da tsaro
  • Gudanar da zurfafaffen aikin gano kurakurai da gyara su (nazarin bayanan faɗuwar manhaja, gano kurakurai a cikin ƙwayar tsarin aiki, nazarin jerin kiran ayyuka, da kuma lokaci-lokaci, warware ƙirar manhaja don fahimtar yadda take aiki)
  • Rubuta takardun bayanin fasaha masu haske waɗanda za su daɗe suna amfani
  • Shiga cikin yanke shawarwari kan tsarin gine-gine na ƙasan matakai da kuma muhimman bitar code
  • Ci gaba da bibiyar sababbin abubuwa game da tsarin cikin gida na Windows da kayan aikin matakin tsarin aiki

Ƙwarewar Fasaha da Ake Buƙata

  • Zurfin sanin tsarin gine-ginen hanyoyin sadarwar kwamfuta da muhallansu
  • Fahimta mai zurfi kan tushen ilimin sadarwar kwamfuta (TCP/IP, UDP, sarrafa cunkoson bayanai, ketare NAT, ɓoye bayanai, hanyoyin yaɗa bayanai kai tsaye)
  • Ƙwaƙƙwarar fahimtar ginshiƙan tsarin aiki (zarurrukan aiki, tsara jadawalin ayyuka, ƙwaƙwalwa, shigarwa da fitar da bayanai, kafofin haɗin sadarwa)
  • Gogewa a aikace wajen amfani da kayan aikin nazari da gano kurakurai a hanyoyin sadarwa
  • Tabbatacciyar gogewa a kan ɗaya ko fiye daga cikin waɗannan ka’idojin sadarwa: QUIC (dole ne), WebRTC, HLS, RTMP, USB ta hanyar IP
  • Harsunan shirye-shirye: C / C++ / Rust / X86/x64
  • Kayan aiki da muhalli: Git da hanyoyin haɓaka manhaja cikin haɗin gwiwa

Game da Kai

  • Gogewar aiki ta shekaru 5 zuwa 10 a fannin haɓaka manhaja, tare da mai da hankali sosai kan shirye-shiryen sadarwar kwamfuta
  • Gogewa a muhallin na’urorin da aka saka manhaja a cikinsu ko muhallai masu ƙarancin albarkatu
  • Sanin hanyoyin sarrafa sauti da bidiyo, sadarwa kai tsaye, ko ababen more rayuwa na yaɗa shirye-shirye kai tsaye
  • Ilimin sadarwar kwamfuta a matakin ƙwayar tsarin aiki ko aiwatar da hanyoyin jigilar bayanai na musamman
  • Gogewa wajen aiki da tsarin da ke gudana a dandamali daban-daban (Linux, macOS, Windows, tsarin aiki na na’urori masu ɗauke da manhaja a ciki)
  • Tsantseni sosai, ’yancin gudanar da aiki da kanka, da kula da ƙananan bayanai; tare da tsananin sha’awar warware matsalolin fasaha masu wuyar gaske
  • Iya raba ƙwarewa da kuma ba da jagoranci ga ƙananan injiniyoyi
  • Ƙwarewar da za ta ƙara maka daraja: gogewa a fannin tsaron tsarin aiki ko ƙarfafa tsaron sassan Windows, ilimi a fannin warware ƙirar manhaja ko nazarin manhajojin ɓarna, gudummawa ga ayyukan buɗaɗɗen tushe da suka shafi ƙasan matakai ko tsarin aiki
  • Ƙwarewar da za ta ƙara maka daraja: gogewa a muhallai masu tsauraran sharuɗɗa (tsarin da ke amsawa nan take, tsarin da dole ne ya kasance yana aiki kodayaushe, manhajoji masu matuƙar muhimmanci ga tsaro)

Matakan Hira

  • Kiran Tantancewa na Minti 15 — Taƙaitacciyar tattaunawa kan abin da ke ƙarfafa maka gwiwa, dacewarka da matsayin, da amsa tambayoyinka da ba na fasaha ba.
  • Hirar Fasaha da Samfur ta Awa 1, Sau Biyu — Zurfafa nazari kan yadda kake warware matsaloli tare da CTO ɗinmu da/ko babban mai tsara mafita namu
  • Haɗuwa da Ƙungiya — Zama na sakin jiki don tabbatar da cewa ka dace da al’adarmu.

Abin da Muke Bayarwa

  • Ayyuka masu zurfin fasaha waɗanda ke ƙalubalantar tunani
  • Muhallin da ke daraja ainihin ƙwarewar injiniya kuma ya mai da hankali kan fasaha (babu tarurruka ko rahotanni marasa amfani)
  • Cikakken ’yanci wajen yanke shawarwarin fasaha
